buyFreeGame.description: The Free Spin Feature can be instantly activated from the main game by purchasing it for 90 times the current total bet.
buyFreeGame.rule01: • During Free Game Mode, Bonus Multipliers accumulate with each winning combination and persist throughout all the free rounds in Free Game Mode.
buyFreeGame.rule02: • In the Free Spin Feature, the total bet credits remain consistent with the spin that initiated the Free Spin Feature.
buyFreeGame.rule03: • An extra 5 free spins can be granted by landing 3, 4, 5, or 6 Scatter Symbols during the Free Spin Feature, with a unlimited limit of free spins.
buyFreeGame.rule04: • Upon triggering the Free Spin Feature, press the spin button to play automatically until all free spins are exhausted, and the resulting wins are paid.
buyFreeGame.title: Buy Feature

comboMultiplier.rule01: 1. The base game features a "Combo Multiplier" with 5 levels: 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, and 8x.
comboMultiplier.rule02: 2. All winnings, except for "Free Game" wins, are multiplied by the "Combo Multiplier".
comboMultiplier.rule03: 3. The "Combo Multiplier" starts at 1x with the first elimination of wins and payouts.
comboMultiplier.rule04: 4. After the elimination of any wins and payouts at the 1x multiplier level, the Combo Multiplier increases to 2x. Subsequently, it can reach 8x if there is a continuous streak of winnings.
comboMultiplier.rule05: 5. If no winnings occur, the "Combo Multiplier" will be reset to 1x.
comboMultiplier.title: Combo Multiplier

freeSpin.description: Trigger 15 free spins by landing 4, 5, or 6 Scatter Symbols on the reels, respectively.
freeSpin.rule01: • In the Free Spin Feature, when a multiplier symbol hits and the spin yields a win, the multiplier value is included in the overall total multiplier.
freeSpin.rule02: • Throughout the entire round, any new multiplier symbol that hits and results in a win will utilize the total multiplier value to multiply the winnings.
freeSpin.rule03: • An extra 5 free spins can be granted by landing 3, 4, 5, or 6 Scatter Symbols during the Free Spin Feature, with a unlimited limit of free spins.
freeSpin.title: Free Spin Feature

gameRules.rule01: • All symbols pay anywhere on the screen.
gameRules.rule02: • Symbols can generate payouts regardless of their position, and any successful matching combination will trigger a cascading effect until no further winning combinations are achieved.
gameRules.rule03: • The value of the win is determined by the total number of identical symbols on the screen at the end of a spin.
gameRules.rule04: • Malfunction in the game void all plays and payouts.
gameRules.title: Game Rules

goldenNumber.rule01: 1. The "Golden Number" symbol will exclusively appear on reels 2, 3, and 4.
goldenNumber.rule02: 2. The "Golden Number" will transform into the "Star Symbol" after elimination.
goldenNumber.rule03: 3. The "Golden Number" substitutes for the "Normal symbol" to create winning combinations and eliminates those symbols.
goldenNumber.title: Golden Number

multiplierFeature.description: Symbols can generate payouts regardless of their position, and any successful matching combination will trigger a cascading effect until no further winning combinations are achieved.
multiplierFeature.rule01: • Upon the occurrence of a multiplier symbol, it randomly adopts a multiplier value ranging from 2x to 800x.
multiplierFeature.rule02: • Bonus Multiplier symbols may appear during the Base Game or Free Game. In the Base Game, these multipliers accumulate with each spin and are then applied by multiplying the total winning combination for that particular spin at the end.
multiplierFeature.title: Multiplier Feature

payTable.description: WILD substitutes for all symbols except SCATTER
payTable.scatterDescription:
This is the Scatter symbol.
Scatter pays on any position
payTable.title: PayTable

starSymbol.rule01: 1. The "Super Star" symbol can only transform from the "Golden Number" through elimination.
starSymbol.rule02: 2. The "Star Symbol" has two modes: "Blue Star" and "Super Star".
starSymbol.rule03: 3. When the "Super Star" symbol appears, it will randomly transform 1 to 4 normal symbols (if present) on reels 2 to 5. This transformation does not affect Scatter or Wild symbols.
starSymbol.rule04: 4. The "Blue Star" symbol only transforms the "Golden Number" symbol that has been eliminated from the winning combination.
starSymbol.rule05: 5. Both the "Blue Star" and "Super Star" symbols replace normal symbols, excluding Scatter symbols, in the game.
starSymbol.title: Star Symbol

loadingPage.description01: When the "Super Star" symbol appears, it will randomly transform 1 to 4 normal symbols (if present) on reels 2 to 5.
loadingPage.description02: All winnings, except for "Free Game" wins, are multiplied by the "Combo Multiplier".
